title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Match purchase invoices to multiple order and receipt lines (new Get Order Lines action)
summary: BC28 adds a Get Order Lines action on purchase invoices. It matches invoice lines to many purchase order lines and posted receipt lines, which is more flexible than the existing one-to-one Get Receipt Lines action. It works for received and non-received order lines. An optional Receipt on Invoice toggle on the order creates receipts when the invoice is posted. A Matched Order Lines page is used to review and adjust the matches.
key_points: The new Get Order Lines action lets you match one invoice line to multiple purchase order lines, not just one-to-one matching
You can match invoice lines to orders whether or not receipts have been posted, providing flexibility for non-received goods
The Receipt on Invoice toggle automatically creates receipts when the invoice is posted, streamlining the workflow
The feature has limitations: no prepayments, item charges, projects, subcontracting, blanket orders, or intercompany transactions
Matched Invoice Lines field on purchase orders tracks quantities matched via invoice lines
features: Match purchase invoices to multiple order and receipt lines

quotes.text: You can match each invoice line to any number of purchase order lines, regardless of whether receipts exist.
quotes.why_it_matters: This shows the core flexibility gain: matching is decoupled from receipt status, enabling more workflows than the previous line-to-line approach

quotes.text: When you turn on the new Receipt on Invoice toggle on the order, posting the linked invoice automatically creates the required receipts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the automation benefit that can reduce manual receipt entry steps when invoicing non-received orders
